column3: Fought hard for restraint early - Disputed the front - Driven to challenge again approaching 2f out - Drifted off a true line and lost the advantage over 1f out - Carried right - Responded inside the final 110 yards to retake the front close home

Dwelt at the start - Settled towards the back early - Made rapid progress to close on the leader 2f out - Bumped but got up in front over 1f out - Soon edged right - Stayed on but was overtaken close home
Tracked the pace early - Sent along and slipped to last approaching 2f out - Soon faded
settled towards the back early - improved from 2f out - took over 1f out under pressure - ran on strongly to score
made the running from the start - pushed along with two furlongs left - overtaken approaching the final furlong - held on gamely for second
raced in the pack early - asked for effort passing 2f out and kept finding more to move into third with 110 yards left - without threatening the front two
settled towards the back early - made headway on the inner with 4f left - up to second with 3f to run - pushed along 2f out - faded inside the final furlong
up with the front pair before being asked for effort with 2f to run - dropped away 1f out
racing close to the pace before fading fast with 2f to run - allowed to coast through the final furlong
Handy with the pace early - Nudged along 3f out - Made steady progress to close on the front over 2f out - Stayed on to hit the front inside the final furlong - Held on well to the finish
Pulled hard in behind early - Racing in the pack - Sent along over 2f out - Made ground entering the final furlong - Stayed on in the winner's wake without closing the gap
Handy early - Nudged along 3f out and made ground to close up over 1f out - Rallied to hold third despite a momentary dip entering the final 110 yards

Fought for restraint early - Racing close up - Went to the front approaching 4f out - Niggled along 2f out - Saw the lead cut back entering the final furlong - Overtaken soon after and slipped back to fourth towards the finish
Dwelt at the start - Restrained towards the back - Sent along over 2f out - Stayed on in the final furlong without threatening
Fought for restraint early - Racing in the pack - Sent along over 3f out - Made modest ground over 1f out but couldn't add to it
Racing in the pack - Sent along over 3f out - Stayed on at one speed over 1f out
Set the pace - Overtaken approaching 4f out and niggled along 3f out - Faded from 2f out
Racing in the pack - Sent along over 3f out and again 2f out - Soon faded
Pulled hard for restraint early - Never got competitive and was behind throughout
Struggled to get involved and towards the rear throughout the race
led from the off - asked for effort with 2f to run - had to dig in under pressure with 1f left - found enough to deny the second by a narrow margin

travelled freely up with the pace early before dropping towards the back - made progress with 3f to run - asked to quicken 2f out - closed on the front-runner with 1f to run - battled to the line but narrowly denied
raced up with the front group early - asked for effort with 2f to run and slipped back a spot - stuck on at one gear for third
raced up with the front group early - asked for effort with 2f to run before edging left and fading from there
held up towards the back - asked for effort with 4f to run before dropping away with 3f left - not knuckled down from 2f out
Restrained towards the back early - Sent along and made strong progress to hit the front 2f out - Opened up a big advantage entering the final furlong and was driven out to the finish
Made the running early - Overtaken after 1f - Made ground and sent along 2f out - Passed by the winner over 1f out and stayed on at one speed

Dwelt at the start - Fought for restraint - Restrained towards the back - Nudged along but lost ground approaching 3f out - Stayed on in the final furlong - Improved to third towards the finish without threatening the front two
Racing close up - Sent along and still fully involved 2f out - Stayed on at one speed in the final furlong but surrendered third towards the finish

Fought for restraint early - Racing close up - Went to the front after 1f - Eight lengths to the good after 5f - Margin cut back 3f out - Sent along and overtaken 2f out - Slipped back over 1f out - Stayed on at one speed to the finish
led from the start - asked for effort with 2f to run - driven out with 1f to run - stayed on strongly without a serious threat
racing close up in second early - asked for effort with 2f to run and unable to close down the winner
slow to begin and settled towards the back - asked for effort with 2f to run - drifted right inside the final furlong and stuck on at one gear
Fought for restraint early - Restrained towards the back - Sent along and made strong progress over 1f out - Edged left to hit the front entering the final 110 yards and stayed on well to the finish
Fought for restraint early - Went to the front - Sent along over 2f out - Margin cut back entering the final furlong - Carried left and overtaken entering the final 110 yards to finish second best
Travelled alone on the near rail early - Sent along over 2f out - Soon slipped back and drifted left - Stayed on inside the final furlong to improve into third by the finish

Fought for restraint early - Handy with the pace - Sent along over 2f out - Slipped back entering the final furlong - Closing on the front pair in the final 110 yards but unable to retain third by the finish
Fought for restraint early - Racing close up and sent along over 2f out - Weakened in the final furlong
Racing in the pack - Sent along 2f out and made ground over 1f out - Soon faded
Fought for restraint early - Restrained towards the back and sent along over 2f out - Unable to make an impact entering the final furlong
Broke smartly from the stalls - Restrained in the pack - Sent along over 2f out - Soon lost touch
racing close to the pace early - asked for effort and went clear with 1f to run - found more under pressure to score readily
made the running from the start - asked for effort with 2f to run - asked again and overtaken with 1f to run - held on for a share at one gear
racing in the pack early - found for effort with 2f to run to move into third with 1f left - held that spot to the line at one gear
sat in behind the front-runner - asked for effort with 2f to run - drifted left soon after and made no further ground
raced up with the front group - asked for effort with 2f to run - found nothing extra when pressed with 1f to run
raced up with the front group before being asked for effort with 2f to run - faded inside the final furlong
held up towards the back - dropped away before the final furlong
Racing in the pack - Sent along over 2f out - Made ground entering the final furlong - Fought out a prolonged battle with the second placed horse in the final 110 yards to get up close home
Set the pace - Sent along as a market rival drew level 2f out - Stayed on entering the final furlong - Locked in a prolonged battle with the winner in the final 110 yards - Overtaken close home
Racing in the pack - Sent along over 2f out - Made ground over 1f out to move into third entering the final 110 yards - Unable to find more
Restrained towards the back - Angled right and sent along over 2f out - Stayed on in the final furlong to move up into fourth towards the finish
Restrained towards the back - Made easy progress 2f out - Denied a clean passage and short of room over 1f out - Soon eased right but stayed on without much luck
Racing close up - Sent along to share the front 2f out - Drifted left over 1f out - Soon overtaken and faded in the final 110 yards
Handy with the pace - Sent along to share the front 2f out - Overtaken entering the final furlong and soon dropped away
Fought for restraint early - Racing close up and sent along over 2f out - Soon faded
Fought for restraint early - Handy with the pace - Sent along towards the back over 2f out - Soon faded
drifted right from the stalls - travelled freely up with the front-runner early - hit the front with 2f to run - asked for effort with 1f to run - stayed on strongly for a comfortable success
settled towards the back - made ground with 2f to run - asked for effort with 1f to run to move into second inside the final 110 yards - unable to trouble the winner
racing close to the pace - asked for effort with 2f to run - kept on without ever getting on terms with the front two
raced up with the leading group - asked for effort with 2f to run - made no further headway
travelled freely and set the pace before being overtaken with 2f to run - drifted left and dropped away with 1f to run
Fought for restraint early - Racing in the pack - Sent along over 2f out - Made ground to close on the front runner entering the final furlong - Fought out a prolonged battle to get up close home

Fought for restraint early - Racing close up - Sent along to hit the front over 2f out - Battled to retain the advantage entering the final furlong - Locked in a prolonged struggle before being caught close home
Drifted right at the start - Fought for restraint - Racing close up - Sent along to close on the front runner over 2f out - Involved before fading entering the final furlong and soon dropping away
Dwelt at the start - Restrained towards the back - Angled right approaching 3f out - Soon sent along - Edged right momentarily over 1f out - Stayed on to catch the eye
Dwelt at the start - Restrained towards the back - Sent along over 3f out - Made modest ground despite being denied a clean run over 1f out - Stayed on at one speed to the finish
Fought for restraint early - Set the pace before being sent along and overtaken over 2f out - Faded in the final furlong
Restrained towards the back - Sent along over 2f out - Made slight ground in the final furlong
Fought for restraint early - Handy with the pace before being sent along and slipping back 2f out - Unable to make an impact in the final furlong
Fought for restraint early - Handy with the pace - Sent along over 2f out - Soon faded
Bumped at the start and racing in the pack - Sent along and slipped towards the back approaching 3f out - Faded over 1f out
held up towards the back - asked for effort with 3f to run - made rapid progress with 1f to run and went on strongly to hit the front 110 yards out
set the pace from the off - asked for effort with 3f to run - overtaken 110 yards out but battled to the line
raced up with the front-runner before being asked for effort with 3f to run - battled to the line
racing in the pack - asked for effort with 2f to run - made progress with 1f to run but found nothing more
held up towards the back before being asked for effort with 3f to run - battled on to the line
racing in the pack before being asked for effort with 3f to run - faded with 2f to run
handy from the break and soon sharing the lead - went on and asked for an effort - a length clear 1f out and driven out to score

racing handy out wide - settling in the front pack and 4th at halfway - driven over 1f out and up to 3rd early in the final furlong - couldn't reel in the winner and held on for 2nd beaten half a length

racing handy out wide and soon in touch with the front pack - 3rd at halfway and up to 2nd in good order 2f out - driven into 2nd and shifted left over 1f out - unable to get on terms with the winner in the final furlong - stayed on one gait with a strong drive and beaten three-quarters of a length into 3rd
settled in the pack - driven around halfway - in 10th and unable to build on that over 1f out - stayed on at one gait to finish 4th beaten a length and a half

towards the back of the pack and pulling hard early - driven and made a little ground 2f out - 7th when mildly hampered over 1f out - soon under pressure with nothing more to give and stayed on at one gait

racing in the pack down the near rail - 6th at halfway and soon asked to quicken - shifted right over 1f out with little response and up to 4th early in the final furlong - held that gait but found nothing more late on to finish 6th
handy and soon sharing the lead - lost the advantage at halfway but stayed on in 2nd after a squeeze - 3rd when mildly hampered over 1f out and dropped to 5th - had nothing more to give at the finish
settled in the pack - driven 2f out - soon under pressure with little response - stayed on at one gait without ever threatening to be involved
hesitant leaving the stalls - settled towards the back down the rail - driven into the pack 2f out with nothing more to offer
slow to break - drifted right and pulled hard through the pack - 8th at halfway and up to 5th in good order 2f out - driven into 6th 1f out - faded in the final 100 yards

settled towards the back - racing fine enough when short of room 2f out - driven when squeezed for space and hampered over 1f out - blocked for a run once more in 9th and not knocked about once behind late on
handy early - soon sat in behind the front pack - asked for more at halfway - under continued pressure 2f out with nothing more to offer
settled in the pack - 5th at halfway - driven 2f out but found nothing more from over 1f out
settled in the pack - driven 2f out with nothing more to offer
held up at the back throughout without threatening to get involved - driven at halfway and again over 1f out - had nothing more for the finish
held up towards the back of the pack - driven 2f out without getting involved - soon under pressure and faded
hesitant leaving the stalls - restrained towards the back and travelled keenly - driven when edging right 2f out and faded
held up at the back throughout without ever getting competitive - lost touch and driven at halfway - soon faded

Fresh underneath early - Settled in behind the pace - Asked to quicken over 2f out and shared second - Driven to remain firmly in second 1f out - Improved to hit the front near the line for an assured success
Settled behind the pace-setter - Improved to hit the front over 2f out and was driven to stay there past 1f out - Came under pressure inside the final furlong and was overtaken near the line
Soon in front - Asked to quicken but surrendered the advantage over 2f out - Driven out and stayed on strongly to take third
Settled behind the front-runners - Asked to quicken over 2f out in fourth - Soon driven without finding another gear
Held up towards the back - Soon losing touch and driven for a response - Missed the action throughout
Sent to the front early - in command throughout - asked for effort approaching 2f out - went further clear in the final furlong for an untroubled success
Travelled close up early - pressed for a run approaching 2f out - responded gamely in the final furlong - beaten two and three quarter lengths into second
Held up towards the back early - urged along approaching 2f out - shifted right for room over 1f out - stayed on final furlong to finish third beaten four lengths
Raced in the pack early - made progress and was pushed along approaching 1f out - ran on in the final furlong without finding more close home
Towards the back early - improved position approaching 2f out and was niggled along over 1f out - unable to quicken again in the final furlong
Held up at the rear early - driven approaching 2f out - denied a straightforward run and eased right over 1f out before running on in the final furlong
Raced in the pack early - roused approaching 2f out - found nothing more and faded in the final furlong
Raced in the pack early - roused approaching 2f out - faded over 1f out
Raced in the pack early - roused approaching 3f out - faded fast over 2f out
Close to the pace early - roused approaching 2f out - faded over 1f out
Free early in the pack - driven approaching 2f out - faded fast over 1f out
close order early - hit the front inside the final two furlongs - ran on strongly to the line
made the running - driven out after the last - overtaken approaching the finish but held on for the runner-up spot
raced behind the pace - up to third with two furlongs left - unable to find more under pressure
raced wide early - towards the back before the third - driven out but not a factor
well placed early - untidy at the last fence and driven forward - dropped back and offered nothing
refused to line up at the start
up with the pace early - dropped in and asked for effort after the first furlong - short of room 1f out - quickened into the last furlong - fought back to get up close home
sluggish start before surging to the front inside the first furlong - asked for effort 2f out - driven when caught inside the final furlong - weakened when overtaken close home
back of the field early - made ground over 1f out - driven inside the final furlong - stayed on but could not match the front two close home
shared the front early before easing back to mid-division - asked for effort 2f out - drifted left under pressure inside the final 110yds - faded towards the finish
shared the early pace and raced close up - came under pressure over 1f out - lost ground inside the final furlong - slipped to the back inside the final 110yds

shared the front early and remained close up after the first furlong - asked for effort over 1f out - faded in a hurry to last inside the final furlong - given a breather having fallen off the pace inside the final 110yds
Handy early - shown the whip approaching final furlong - quickened clear to prevail
Sat behind the pace - roused 1f out - rallied final furlong to snatch second close home
Set the pace - shaken up 1f out - overtaken final furlong to drop to third close home
Free-going in behind - pushed forward 1f out - one-paced to the line
Sat behind the pace - urged 2f out - lost ground 1f out
Settled off the pace - driven 2f out - showed nothing final furlong
swung left over a few fences and raced in the pack - pushed into contention 2 out - asserted last to hit the front - edged right closing in - gap narrowed but scrambled home in front
raced in the pack - close up on the front-runner 2 out - improved into range approaching the last - shadowed the winner to the line and stayed second
raced in the pack - denied room to challenge 2 out - eased left for space - battled on up the run-in to move into third
raced in the pack close to the front group - hampered for room 2 out and eased left approaching the last - battled on yet surrendered third close to home
pulled hard early - settled in the pack - improved to challenge the front-runner before 2 out - looked full of running approaching the last - faded in the closing 110 yards
held up towards the back - made ground on the outside 3 out and closed up 2 out - stayed on at an unchanged gallop into the last
went to the front for a spell early - sat close to the pace - rallied to nose in front before 2 out - lost that advantage at the last and faded
up with the pace for a spell before going to the front - overtaken before 2 out - lost ground steadily from there
raced in fits and starts - restrained at the back - toiling from 3 out - stayed on up the run-in without threatening
restrained in the pack - toiling from 3 out - blundered 2 out and faded up the run-in
up with the pace early - pushed along after the 6th - slipped to the back 3 out and made no headway before 2 out
raced in the pack - edged left and up with the pace at the 6th - lost ground after 3 out and was pulled up before 2 out

sharing the early pace and soon in front after 1f - driven over 2f out and given a hard race for the lead - squeezed out of that position fractionally over 1f out - fought back in front in the final 150 yards - driven out to the line to just prevail

sat in behind the front pack and improved from 4th at halfway to 2nd over 2f out - driven to close the gap and went in front by a whisker when drifting right over 1f out - wandered and lost that spot by the same sliver in the final 150 yards - driven out and responded gamely - beaten a nose

restrained handy early and pulling hard - 3rd at halfway and back to 4th early in the straight after a squeeze - driven 2f out without getting on terms - up to 3rd in the final 100 yards and stayed on at one gait
restrained handy early - towards the back at halfway - driven entering the straight without getting on terms 2f out - stayed on at one gait to move up into 4th in the final 100 yards

fighting for the front from the stalls and soon settled towards the back - 5th at halfway - driven entering the straight and again 2f out without getting on terms over 1f out - had nothing more in the final 100 yards

sharing the lead and travelling keenly early - lost that spot after 1f and sat behind the new pacesetter - driven entering the straight - 3rd over 2f out and soon under a ride without getting on terms when hampered over 1f out - soon faded
Close to the pace early - pushed for effort approaching 2f out - improved to hit the front in the final furlong - pulled further clear towards the line for an impressive success

Missed the break - settled towards the back of the pack - driven approaching 3f out - made late progress over 1f out - ran on well in the final furlong - grabbed second inside the final 110 yards but not good enough for the winner
Set the pace early - pushed along approaching 2f out - overtaken in the final furlong - faded fast and surrendered second near the line
Dwelt at the back early - roused approaching 3f out and improved over 1f out - responded strongly in the final furlong
Handy in the first half - roused approaching 3f out - found nothing more and continued at an unchanged gear over 1f out - never posed a threat to the front-runners
Free early in the pack - driven approaching 2f out - faded over 1f out
Held up towards the back for the whole trip - made no impact on proceedings
well placed early and disputed the front after the sixth - untidy at the eighth - driven out approaching the last - ran on well to open a clear advantage
settled off the pace early - made better progress from two out - up into fourth after the last and closed under pressure - outpaced in the closing stages to take second
settled behind the leading group - driven out approaching the last - stayed on without threatening to close
set the pace - overtaken after the sixth but stayed on terms - weakened with two out
raced handy - clipped the sixth - driven out with two furlongs left and faded in the final furlong
started at the back - sluggish over the first - never featured for the remainder
held up towards the back - improved into contention by the sixth and briefly into a forward position - dropped away under pressure four out - well held with two out
raced in the pack - untidy at the seventh - clipped the following obstacle and toiling - driven out three out but found nothing
set the pace from the front and had to fight off a determined rival inside the final furlong - just passed close home - battled back to prevail on the line
sat second early - driven to chase down the leader inside the final furlong - nosed ahead inside the final 110yds before running out of steam and being caught on the line
held up towards the back - moved off the rail to improve over 1f out - stayed on without finding more towards the finish
sluggish start before settling towards the back - made ground into mid-division before halfway - driven to close on the front-runners inside the final 110yds and stayed on
settled in third before beginning to weaken 4f out - soon toiling and last of all - allowed to coast home having fallen away over 1f out
Handy early - roused to go clear 1f out - fought off pressure final furlong to prevail
Set the pace - challenged and passed 1f out - battled to the line narrowly beaten
Handy early - driven 2f out - held on to finish third
Settled off the pace - driven 2f out - closed late but not competitive
Fighting for restraint in the pack - driven 2f out - made late gains but not competitive
Restrained at the back - urged 2f out - picked off tiring runners final furlong
Racing in mid-division - urged 2f out - soon struggling
Racing in mid-division - driven 2f out - soon outpaced
Handy behind the pace - driven and dropped back 2f out - soon toiling
Restrained at the back - urged 2f out - always struggling
settled in the pack - handy on the front group 4 out - improved to hit the front before 3 out - opened daylight before the last - finished strongly

handy early - shared the front at the 5th - went clear in front by the 7th - caught by a rival at the 11th before retaking command 4 out - overtaken before 3 out - battled on at an unchanged gallop before the last

shared command early - asserted alone before the 3rd - caught by a rival at the 5th - overtaken by the 7th - dropped towards the back before the 11th - moved into a workmanlike third 3 out - stayed on up the run-in without threatening those in front
sketchy over the fences - restrained at the back - pushed along after the 10th - dropped right away 4 out but rallied for a workmanlike fourth up the run-in

shared command early - overtaken before the 3rd - sluggish at the 4th - hampered at the 8th - pushed along before the 13th - lost touch towards the back before 3 out and made no further progress before the last
never got competitive
raced in the pack - veered left at the 8th - shared command at the 11th - overtaken 4 out and lost ground before 3 out

handy early and soon sitting behind the front group - 5th at halfway - made ground in good order early in the straight and went in front 2f out - driven and took control soon after - given a squeeze and three lengths clear 1f out - ran out an easy winner

restrained towards the back and pulling hard - 8th at halfway - racing well enough when short of room 2f out - soon moved to the outside and made ground - driven up into 3rd over 1f out - 2nd early in the final furlong - couldn't get on terms with the winner and stayed on at one gait

settled at the back and needed time to find a rhythm - soon pulling hard - 9th at halfway - racing fine enough when short of room over 2f out - driven up into 6th and moved to the outside over 1f out - up to 4th but unable to get on terms early in the final furlong - held that effort for 3rd late on

restrained towards the back - made ground on the outer in good order over 2f out and up to 3rd - driven into 2nd and drifted right 1 1/2f out - unable to get on terms when drifting right once more over 1f out - back to 3rd early in the final furlong - stayed on at one gait and had nothing more in 4th late on

settled in the pack and pulling hard - 7th at halfway - driven and made ground over 2f out - up to 3rd when carried right 1 1/2f out - back to 4th unable to get on terms when carried right once more over 1f out - had nothing more

settled in the pack down the inside - 6th at halfway - driven and made a little ground over 2f out - up to 5th when carried right 1 1/2f out - unable to get on terms when carried right once more and hampered on the rail over 1f out with nothing more
sat behind the front pack - 3rd at halfway - driven into 2nd 3f out - went in front 2 1/2f out - driven again but lost that spot 2f out and faded fast
sat behind the front pack down the inside - 4th at halfway - driven 3f out - under continued pressure 2f out without getting on terms and faded
sharing the lead - lost that spot after 2f and sat behind the new pacesetter - driven back in front 3f out - lost that position again 2 1/2f out - driven into 3rd 2f out and faded fast
sharing the lead - went in front after 2f - driven approaching the straight - lost that spot 3f out and faded fast

Missed the break - raced in the pack - driven approaching 3f out - angled left for room over 2f out - made late progress to close on the front-runner in the final furlong - responded well inside the final 110 yards - got the decision by a whisker close home
Set the pace early - roused approaching 3f out - fought back gamely with rivals tight on both flanks in the final furlong - caught close home and beaten by a whisker into second

Missed the break - raced in the pack - roused approaching 2f out - made late progress to get within range of the front two in the final furlong - ran on towards the line but denied by a short margin close home
Close to the pace early - driven approaching 3f out - responded to close on the front-runner in the final furlong - narrowly denied towards the finish
Close to the pace early - driven approaching 3f out - faded over 1f out
Held up at the back throughout
Held up at the back for the whole trip
chased the front-runner from the off - driven out with two out - went on in the final furlong - held on for a narrow success

raced in the pack - driven out after the twelfth and found more - stayed on approaching the finish - moved into fourth with two furlongs remaining - chased the winner home in the final 110 yards but narrowly denied
handy early - in touch with the pace from the sixth - up into third at the last where untidy - kept on grimly but narrowly denied
made the running under pressure from the off - driven out with two out and edged clear - overtaken in the final furlong and dropped back two positions
settled at the back - made progress four out - clipped the second last and squeezed for room on the turn after the last - driven out but made no further impact
held up towards the back - made ground four out - shared fourth at the last fence under a drive - faded with two furlongs left
settled towards the back of the pack - made progress by the ninth - shared third at the thirteenth - dropped back with two out and well held
raced in touch with the pace - driven out and lost ground before the last
raced in the pack - niggled at by the twelfth and dropped away - pulled up after the fourteenth
handy early - blundered the first - faded meekly by the thirteenth and pulled up soon after
settled towards the back - surged through the field from 1f out - shared the front inside the final 110yds - kept finding more to get there right on the line
held up towards the back - made strong progress from over 1f out - went for the front inside the final 110yds before finding no more and being passed close home
set the pace before being driven inside the final furlong - emptied when overtaken inside the final 110yds - found no more towards the finish
raced up with the pace - driven to close on the front-runners inside the final furlong - stayed on
raced up with the pace - driven soon after halfway - faded inside the final furlong
sluggish start and settled towards the back - asked for effort 2f out - closed on the front-runners inside the final furlong before faltering - soon allowed to coast home
never better than towards the back - began toiling and losing touch 1f out - given a breather inside the final 110yds
held towards the back and never troubled the pace - faded fast and was given a breather over 1f out
In pursuit early - driven to draw level 2f out - went ahead 1f out and finished strongly
Set the pace - driven 2f out as rivals closed - overtaken 1f out - kept going to the finish
In pursuit of the pace - driven 2f out - stayed on for third
In pursuit of the pace - driven 3f out - found nothing more
Towards the back - driven 3f out - faded 2f out

restrained in the pack - sluggish at the 6th - made easy progress 4 out - challenged the front-runner 3 out - went to the front 2 out - opened a two-length gap before the last and stayed on for a comfortable win
raced in the pack - travelling comfortably and close to the front group 3 out - pushed along soon after - shared second approaching the last but could not find more and stayed there
raced in the pack - travelling comfortably in third 3 out - given a squeeze soon after - shared second approaching the last but surrendered the spot close home
raced in the pack - sketchy at the 8th - pushed along before 4 out - close up 3 out - moved into fourth at the last and battled on at an unchanged gallop
went to the front early - pushed along and fought to hold the advantage 3 out - overtaken 2 out and faded
never landed among the front-runners
up with the pace early - blundered 4 out and dropped back through the field under pressure - never got competitive towards the tail 3 out
never got competitive - fell 3 out

sat behind the front pack and soon in 3rd pulling hard - driven 2f out - under continued pressure and made further inroads over 1f out - up to 2nd 1f out and soon in front - drifted left in the final 100 yards - driven out to prevail

ran in isolation early - handy and travelling keenly - soon sitting behind the pacesetter - tight in 2nd 2f out - driven into the lead 1 1/2f out - under continued pressure but lost that spot early in the final furlong - unable to get back on terms and stayed on one gait
restrained handy early - a modest 5th at halfway - driven 2f out and made further inroads into 4th over 1f out - up to 3rd early in the final furlong - unable to get on terms and stayed on one gait

handy behind the front group early - lost ground to the back after 1f - driven and isolated at halfway - under continued pressure without getting on terms 2f out - found more to move up into 4th inside the final 100 yards - held that gait but narrowly missed out on 3rd
restrained handy early - driven in a modest 6th at halfway - under continued pressure over 1f out without getting on terms
